properties.summary: Protocol for extracting design DNA from screenshot or URL. Two modes: image and URL. Five-step protocol (Surface, Type, Structure, Motion, Rhythm). Refusal heuristics for paid templates/signature work. Structured schema output. Theme mapping table. Diagnosis report templates. design.md emission with attestation layer.

properties.description: Study protocol depends on structure.md for macrostructure matching and component archetype identification, and on slop-test.md for refusal heuristics and anti-pattern detection during diagnosis. The 5-step protocol (Surface→Type→Structure→Motion→Rhythm) maps source designs to macrostructures and themes defined in structure.md, while anti-pattern diagnostics use the slop-test named tells.
